thesis: The bull establishes business quality but not a present entry valuation, and the bear establishes timing and cash-conversion concerns without showing permanent impairment. A neutral watch stance best represents that distinction; a strong MA-distance rank does not override the short-term deterioration.
strongest_counterexample: Revenue, operating income and adjusted EPS grew in the official release while observed leverage remained modest, leaving substantial capacity to fund growth through temporary cash-conversion pressure.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy if price holds above SMA50 for five consecutive closes and the next report shows FCF above the current $18.633B observation.
Reconsider toward sell if revenue declines year over year for two reported quarters and FCF falls below the current observation in both.
evidence_gaps: Return and cash-conversion path of the growing investment commitments.
Verified durable earnings impact, if any, of the service disruption or new launches.
decisive_factors: Strong official growth and high profitability.
FCF lower than the year-ago observation with higher capex.
Price below SMA20/50 despite positive longer-term MA distance.
